reviewer_role: Senior Visual QA & Technical Design Reviewer

immediate_comprehension.notes: The visual distinction between unsorted heap storage and sorted auxiliary B-tree structure is immediately clear. A developer understands within 3 seconds why scanning is necessary and how the B-tree divides and conquers the search space.

composition_and_spacing.notes: The center stage in Beats 1-2 is now purposeful with architectural heap annotations and dynamic disk-block inspection status. Beat 6 contrast overlay is clean with zero background text collision.

focal_hierarchy.notes: Clear visual hierarchy anchored by the top query HUD, energetic orange (#eb6c36) search path, and emerald green (#2a9d8f) confirmation on matched row 77.

semantic_correctness.notes: Physical storage rows are realistically unordered ([42, 09, 23, 89, 15, 93, 04, 71, 55, 31, 77, 99, 48, 82, 97, 63]). The auxiliary B-tree is sorted ([04|15], [23|31], [42|55], [71|77|89]). Pointer indirection accurately reflects physical RowID page retrieval.

graphical_craftsmanship.notes: Museum-quality paper/ink aesthetic (#f5f5f5, #2d3142). Subtle 40px grid texture, crisp vector line weights (1.5px - 3.5px), exact corner radiuses, and refined typography.

motion_clarity_and_pacing.notes: Deterministic Remotion timing across all 900 frames. 15-frame row inspection cadence in scan, clean 3-step tree descent, fluid 40-frame pointer ray arc, and smooth easing transitions.

professional_polish.notes: Completely avoids generic web UI cards, arbitrary 3D, and AI gradient clichés. Presents as a publication-grade technical explainer.

corrections_verified.verification: Rows in heap storage now display realistic unsorted order, proving why a sequential scan cannot binary search raw table pages.
Beats 1-2 now feature physical architecture concept labels and dynamic row-by-row mismatch inspection badges in the center area.
B-Tree elements and pointers smoothly fade out prior to the entry of the Beat 6 Performance Contrast card, eliminating text overlap.
Leaf key 77 is individually underlined and highlighted; pointer ray originates directly from key 77 and connects seamlessly to the top border of target Row #11.

remaining_visible_weaknesses: In high-density display scaling, very subtle sub-pixel antialiasing on dashed SVG connector lines when dimmed to 18% opacity.
No voiceover audio is rendered in the video file because Karve has no native TTS engine (narration script is cleanly provided in narration.txt).
